subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ133S across its F-Pace X761, XF X250 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ133S is fitted to two high-performance Jaguar models — the F-Pace SVR and XF XFR-S — with SVR-specific tuning that places additional stress on components compared to standard AJ133 applications.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required, supercharger coupler, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The AJ133S shares the known issue pattern of the broader AJ133 engine family — timing chain failure (particularly on early engines), supercharger coupler wear causing rattling, and cooling system leaks from pipes, hoses, and connectors. The SVR-specific higher output places additional stress on these components.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ133S rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ133S REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ133S supercharger sits on top of the engine and must be removed to access the valley where the oil cooler, timing chain, and other critical components reside. The SVR-specific higher output places additional stress on timing chain and cooling system components compared to standard AJ133 applications. Early AJ133 engines (2009–2012) are most affected by timing chain issues — though the AJ133S is a later variant, the same design characteristics apply. Plastic coolant pipes and heat exchangers are known failure points and are inspected during strip-down. LAYER 3 — SEARCH COVERAGE

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain components, main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, supercharger coupler, oil filter housing gasket

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
